paused.description: This card is paused and will not move until it is resumed.

merge-blocker.suggestedAction: Open the Review tab to resolve the merge blocker.
merge-blocker.headline: Merge is blocked

agent-approval.suggestedAction: Open the approvals inbox to approve or deny.
agent-approval.description: The agent paused itself until a person approves the pending permission request.
agent-approval.headline: A tool call is waiting for your approval

wedge.description: A durable stuck-state hold is in place on this card.
wedge.headline: This card is stuck waiting for a decision
wedge.suggestedAction: Review the stuck-state notice and take its suggested action, or let recovery retry.

stalled-review.headline: Review appears stalled
stalled-review.suggestedAction: Re-dispatch the review or open the activity log for detail.

failed.suggestedAction: Retry the card, or open the detail to read the failure.
failed.description: The last run ended in a failure without a captured error message.
failed.headline: This card failed

overlap-block.suggestedAction: Let the overlapping card land, or narrow this card's file scope.
overlap-block.description: Another active card is editing the same files, so this card is held to avoid a conflict.
overlap-block.headline: Waiting on file overlap with {{taskId}}

completion-blocker.headline: Completion is blocked
completion-blocker.suggestedAction: Open the detail to resolve the completion blocker.

queued.headline: Waiting to be picked up
queued.suggestedAction: No action needed; reorder or assign the card if a different one should run first.

plan-admission-throttled.headline: Waiting for a planner slot
plan-admission-throttled.description: The planner is at capacity with other cards, so it has not taken this one yet. It will when a slot frees.
plan-admission-throttled.suggestedAction: Wait for a planner slot to free, or start planning from the card now.

plan-lane-ineligible.headline: This lane does not plan cards automatically
plan-lane-ineligible.description: Nothing is refusing this card: the planning lane it sits in is not configured to plan cards of this kind.
plan-lane-ineligible.suggestedAction: Start planning from the card, or move it to a lane that plans automatically.

plan-premise-held.headline: Planning is held by a rejected plan
plan-premise-held.description: The last plan was refused for contradicting its own stated premises, so planning waits for a corrected one.
plan-premise-held.suggestedAction: Correct the plan's premises, then request planning again from the card.

plan-spec-unreadable.headline: The written plan cannot be read
plan-spec-unreadable.description: The plan exists in task storage but cannot be read from it, so planning cannot start.
plan-spec-unreadable.suggestedAction: Re-save the plan from the card, or request a new one.

plan-recovery-backoff.headline: Waiting out a scheduled retry
plan-recovery-backoff.description: Planning failed earlier and is parked until its scheduled retry time.
plan-recovery-backoff.suggestedAction: Nothing to do until the retry time, or start planning from the card now.

plan-no-admission.headline: Planning has not started, and no gate refuses it
plan-no-admission.description: This card has waited past the planning age with no admission recorded and no gate that can be named as the reason.
plan-no-admission.suggestedAction: Open the card and request planning again.

recoverable-work.headline: This card's branch holds commits that are not merged
recoverable-work.description: Work exists on the branch this card claims that the card itself does not show.
recoverable-work.suggestedAction: Open the branch to recover the commits, then retry or re-plan the card.

awaiting-review-revision.description: The latest review asked for changes and this card still has unfinished remediation steps, so it is working rather than waiting on anyone.
awaiting-review-revision.headline: Applying review corrections
awaiting-review-revision.suggestedAction: Let the next review round run; open the Review tab only if the remediation steps stop moving.

agent-rate-limited.suggestedAction: No action needed unless it is still rate limited after the retry.
agent-rate-limited.description: The engine will retry automatically at {{retryAt}} — nothing needs fixing.
agent-rate-limited.headline: The provider is rate limiting this agent

database.embeddedConnectionCapHelp: Fusion 내장 PostgreSQL의 최대 서버 연결 수. Fusion 재시작 후 적용. 범위: 32–2,000. 기본적으로 미설정 — Fusion이 500을 선택하며, 각 연결이 별도 프로세스인 Windows에서는 150을 사용합니다(높은 한도는 백엔드 충돌을 유발할 수 있음). 외부 PostgreSQL은 제공자 연결 한도를 사용합니다.

schedulingGlobal.verificationCpuIoWeightHelp: Machine-wide CPU/IO weight while unthrottled (1–10000; lower keeps the desktop responsive). Empty = default 10. 0 disables weight shaping machine-wide.
schedulingGlobal.verificationCpuQuotaPercentHelp: Machine-wide CPUQuota per verification (200 = 2 cores) for projects that do not set their own. Empty = derived default: roughly half the machine's cores, at least 100%. 0 disables bounding machine-wide.
schedulingGlobal.verificationMemoryMaxMbHelp: Machine-wide MemoryMax per verification, in MB. Empty = no memory cap. 0 disables the cap machine-wide.
